name: wargame
description: Meta loop + eval system for product engineering. Wargame missions on paper before execution: BRIEF, WARGAME, GRADE, RED-TEAM, EXECUTE, VERIFY, RETRO. Plans graded pass/fail against a 9-point rubric plus repo extensions, red-teamed until an honest break attempt fails, then handed to a cheaper executor. Every artifact the executor is graded against is read-only to it; every verification command is validated against known-good and known-bad input before the route trusts it. Ledger tracks predicted-vs-actual; retros patch the system itself.
